full_prompt_en: A square painted illustration shows a tabby cat sitting among oversized flowers and layered geometric garden shapes. The background is a dense patchwork of narrow verticals, rectangles, leaves, and dark blue-purple spaces, rather than a distant natural landscape. Near the upper left, a large warm yellow circle is partly cut by the frame and crossed by dark straight bars. The cat fills the central area from its raised ears to the lower edge, with its head turned toward the left. One amber eye catches light beneath a sharply angled brow; the pink nose and pale whiskers project into the darker flower-filled side of the image. The upright ears are coral and gray inside, while the forehead and cheek are built from facets of yellow, orange, rust, burgundy, and cool blue shadow. A broad white-gray chest occupies the middle lower portion, broken by short painted strokes that suggest soft fur without copying each strand. Across the right shoulder and flank, curved dark stripes make a strong rhythmic pattern over warm golden patches. On the left, large purple blossoms and red-orange flowers rise from crowded stems. Smaller leaves and flower shapes spread behind the cat on the right, and a small yellow-and-black butterfly hovers near the upper right corner. The vegetation, bars, and animal contours overlap in shallow layers, creating a lively graphic surface. Painted marks are angular and visibly placed, with crisp color boundaries interrupted by smaller soft strokes in the fur and petals. Light appears warm from the upper left, brightening the face and ears while cooler blue and violet shadows settle into the background. The overall composition is exuberant but organized: a large warm central silhouette anchors a tapestry of jewel-colored botanical and geometric accents.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形绘画插图呈现一只虎斑猫，坐在放大的花朵和层叠的几何花园形状之间。背景是窄竖线、矩形、叶片和深蓝紫色区域组成的密集拼缀，而不是延向远方的自然景观。左上方，一个温暖的大黄圆被画框截断，并被深色直杆横穿。猫从竖起的耳朵一直延伸到下缘，占据中央，头转向左侧。一只琥珀色眼睛在斜挑的眉脊下接住光，粉红鼻尖与浅色胡须伸向较暗、满是花朵的左侧。竖耳内侧呈珊瑚色和灰色，额头与脸颊则由黄、橙、锈红、酒红和冷蓝阴影的色块组成。宽阔的灰白胸口占据中下部，以短笔痕暗示柔软皮毛，而没有逐根描画。右肩与身体侧面，弯曲的深色条纹在暖金色斑块上构成强烈节奏。左边，大朵紫花和红橙色花从拥挤茎秆间升起。较小叶片与花形在猫身后右侧展开，右上角附近悬着一只黄黑色小蝴蝶。植被、直杆和动物轮廓在浅层次中互相遮挡，形成活跃的图形表面。颜料痕迹棱角分明且落笔可见，清晰色彩边界被皮毛和花瓣中的较柔软小笔触打断。光似乎从左上方温暖地照来，提亮面部与耳朵，冷蓝和紫色阴影则落在背景里。整体构图热烈却有秩序：一个大型暖色中央剪影固定住宝石色植物与几何重音交织的画毯。
style_prompt_en: The painted style uses angular color facets and overlapping graphic shapes to build volume without smooth photographic blending. A warm gold-orange core is countered by deep violet, blue, burgundy, and small bright floral accents, creating saturation through contrast rather than a single uniform hue. Broad planes carry the main form, while short directional strokes add tactile detail where the eye rests. Dark contours appear selectively and break into adjacent color patches instead of enclosing every edge. Repeated straight bars and curving organic marks create a lively tension across a shallow, tightly packed space. Warm upper light lifts selected facets; cooler shadow colors remain visible rather than turning neutral black. Small high-contrast accents circulate around one dominant silhouette and keep the crowded field readable. The overall effect is ornate and energetic, with faceted brushwork, bold color adjacency, and layered surface rhythm controlling the abundance of detail.
style_prompt_zh: 这种绘画风格用棱角分明的色面和互相遮挡的图形形状建立体积，不依赖平滑的摄影式融合。暖金橙色核心与深紫、蓝、酒红及小块明亮花色相对，饱和感来自色彩对照，而非均匀单色。宽阔色面承载主要形体，短促定向笔触在视线停留处增加可触的细节。深色轮廓选择性出现，并裂入相邻色块，而不是封闭每条边。重复直杆与弯曲有机痕迹在浅而紧凑的空间里形成活跃张力。温暖上方光提亮局部色面；阴影保留冷色，而非变成中性黑。小块高对比重音围绕一个主导剪影流动，使拥挤色域仍易辨。整体效果华丽而有能量，由切面式笔触、鲜明相邻色关系和层叠表面节奏控制丰沛细节。
theme_en: A bright tabby cat among flowers and geometric garden patterns
theme_zh: 一只鲜亮的虎斑猫置身花朵与几何花园图案之间
name: Bob Coonts
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
